analyst.summary: Gujarat Ambuja Exports is a diversified agro-processing company (corn starch, edible oils, soya derivatives, feed ingredients) that has grown revenue strongly and consistently over the past year. Profitability had been volatile due to swings in input-output cost spreads, but the most recent two quarters show a genuine, meaningful margin recovery to the best levels in two years. Combined with high promoter ownership, low debt, and a reasonable valuation, we rate this a Hold.
